name: @repo/adapter-config
description: Shared deploy-time toggle layer for the OSS-migration adapter seams. Holds the runtime-agnostic primitives every vendor seam reuses to decide whether it is enabled and which backend (hosted vendor / self-host / no-op) to wire: parseEnvBoolean, firstNonEmpty, resolveNeutralValue (vendor-neutral-with-legacy-fallback name resolution), resolveToggle (the enabled/backend decision + clamp invariant), and warnLegacyOnce (one-time deprecation warning per seam). Pure, runtime-agnostic code — no Node built-ins, no SDK imports, no process access — so it bundles into both the Cloudflare Workers gateway and the Next.js dashboard. Each seam's connection config and its app-side facade live with the seam, not here.
